issues.description: The Person.birthday attribute type is inconsistent between the template/tests and the solution. In the template and tests, birthday is a java.time.LocalDate (used throughout service validation and tests), but in the solution repository the Person class declares the birthday field as String while its getter/setter use LocalDate. This mismatch will cause compilation errors and contradicts the data model expected by PersonService and the tests.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution repository, change the Person.birthday field type from String to java.time.LocalDate so that the field, its getter/setter, PersonService validation, and the tests all use the same LocalDate type. Ensure imports reflect java.time.LocalDate and update any serialization if necessary.
